opening: I have really bad pain in my right arm.
I stumbled over a toy on the floor and tried to brace myself with my right arm, but I ended up landing on my hand.

opening.text: I have really bad pain in my right arm. It started three days ago. I stumbled over a toy on the floor and tried to brace myself with my right arm, but I ended up landing on my hand. Then the pain started gradually.
